findings.title: Dispatch Audio Recording
findings.explanation: While the complaint and opinion mention dispatch providing information to the officers, no audio recording of the dispatch communication appears to be included in the provided evidence.

findings.title: Reason for Traffic Stop
findings.explanation: Multiple sources, including the complaint, the court opinion, and bodycam audio, agree that the officers stated the reason for the stop was a failure to signal.

findings.title: Video Evidence of Signaling
findings.explanation: The complaint and court opinion assert that video evidence shows the signal was activated, while the court also notes that it is not objectively clear from the video whether the signal was activated at the legally required distance.

findings.title: Issuance of Citations
findings.explanation: The complaint, court opinion, and bodycam audio all agree that Rosales was cited for failure to signal and registration-related violations.

findings.title: Denial of Recording Request
findings.explanation: The complaint and court opinion agree that the officers did not permit the occupants to retrieve their phones to record the encounter.

findings.title: Miranda Warnings
findings.explanation: The complaint and court opinion agree that Miranda warnings were provided to Rosales by Officer Lewis.

findings.title: Instruction to Exit Vehicle
findings.explanation: The complaint and court opinion agree that Officer Terrell instructed Rosales to exit the vehicle and that he complied.
